claims.claim: Transfer, Allocate, Adjust, Used, and Unused appear on Available lots. Reallocate moves a patient-allocated lot to a different patient when none of it has been used. Assign to Provider appears when you select lots.
Size is entered at receiving. HCPCS is filled in from the Product Catalog at receiving time. SKU comes from the Product Catalog entry.
A lot shows one of these statuses: Ordered, Shipped, Available, Unused, Reserved, Hold, Receive, Used, Transferred, Returned, Rejected, or Damaged.

In the Interventions & Treatments step (Step 9) the clinician picks the product; the Select Lot list shows each lot with quantity available and expiration, soonest-expiring first, flagging lots that expire within 30 days. The clinician sets Quantity and clicks Confirm Selection.
When the clinician clicks Continue to Review, the selected quantities are deducted from stock. If that fails, the clinician sees "Visit saved, but product use was not recorded"; saving again is safe.
